name: ACS International
summary: ACS-family international school with IB Diploma and a Singaporean institutional backbone — do not confuse with ACS (Independent) local pathways.
body: ACS International offers an international pathway connected to the broader Anglo-Chinese Schools family. It appeals to families wanting IB (often via IGCSE/MYP into DP) with local institutional roots — useful when the university thesis is portable and you still want ACS-brand familiarity. Compare carefully against ACS (Independent) and other MOE-pathway IB schools: those are cut-throat local admissions products, not walk-in international seats. Confirm campus, age range, and current year-group openings on the school site before housing locks. For IB-vs-A-Level decision framing across the island, pair this entity with the secondary pathways guide rather than treating any single ACS campus as the whole map. Careers/CCA offices may broker short work-experience weeks — confirm age/pass compliance and mentor names before treating placements as belonging. Ask how CCA loads interact with external academy calendars for dual-career households, and how fixture changes are communicated. Language evenings and slapped-cheek exclusion weeks both need named dual-career owners — ask admissions how parent language nights are scheduled against bus cutoffs.
waitlistNotes: Secondary entry points are popular — apply on published timelines. Ask which grades still accept mid-year transfers.
